channel.title: Use Superintelligence News
channel.description: Superintelligence news, government AI policy updates and simple AI guides from Use Superintelligence.

item.title: What Is the Super Intelligence Force? Washington's New AI Task Force, Explained
item.description: The White House launched a Super Intelligence Force on October 4, 2026. Who leads it, what it is supposed to do, and why the U.S. government now says "super intelligence" instead of AI.

item.title: The White House Accord and the "No New Law" Charter: How Superintelligence Will Be Governed
item.description: Six AI companies signed a voluntary White House Accord on Super Intelligence, and the new task force adopted a charter that relies on existing law instead of new AI rules. What that means.

item.title: State AI Laws in 2026: Where the Real Rules for Superintelligence Live
item.description: With no comprehensive federal AI law, states are writing the rules. A simple guide to California SB 53, Texas TRAIGA, Colorado's AI Act, Illinois and New York's RAISE Act.
